info.name: Quadrillion Cloud account Latency Distribution API

params.name: all_users
params.description: Return data for all users (admin only opt-in)

items.docs:
Get latency distribution with percentiles (p1, p5, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99)
aggregated by day and model.

Returns latency percentiles for:
- proxy_latency: Time from request received to upstream call initiated
- ttft_latency: Time from upstream call to first byte received (Time To First Token)

Defaults to the caller's own data. Admin users (with @quadrillion.io email)
may opt into cross-user data by passing user_id (specific user) or
